answer: Cross-Attestation Audit Kernel: each agent must periodically submit a signed work receipt co-signed by a random peer drawn from a shared wharf ledger of active tasks. Duplicate agents reuse receipts, so their co-signers collide, triggering disclosure to all peers. An attacker must maintain genuinely distinct peer histories per identity, costing one independent work record and periodic re-attestation per duplicate, scaling linearly with sybil count while single identities pay nothing extra; mismatches flag the account like drift on a tundra.
